obernants.assumptions: Resources available; u32 offsets and enum widths representable, CSR externally validated. Live writes, worker races, write-error handling and full data ingestion are modeled but not run.
obernants.domain: Synthetic UTF8 helper inputs and valid bounded CSR. No teacher/held-out/DB execution. Initial query allowed ambient sense-prior lookup; corrected four isolated runs use absent ONTO_PRIOR.
obernants.observation_scope: coresel uses wdwalk core resolution and corevmm key/verdict readers, build.rs consumes coregate then core.rs includes generated arrays. Graph model feeds store/Kb/query; core checks layer0 Kb properties and ancestry. Builder consumes Zip; judge/corevmm call wdvmm only in unexecuted effectful paths. Passing parser is not successful numeric code emission or teacher correctness.
obernants.operator: Explicit no candidates cannot enter core; absent fields cannot pass completeness; wrong synset candidates cannot substitute senses. Gate success alone does not exclude invalid numeric/identifier emission, and pure response parse cannot exclude teacher or append failures.

Graph admits repeated edges and senses removed by assembly. Parsed risk empty admits none and malformed valid-ID rows, so response reconstruction is not unique.
